newsitem.title: USA: IBM to launch $90 mln AS/400 ad blitz - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: IBM to launch $90 mln AS/400 ad blitz - WSJ.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp is set to launch a $90 million advertising campaign for its latest AS/400 computer line, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The paper said in its electronic edition that the campaign -- which starts this week -- will include in-flight commercials, slick magazine ads and banners on the World Wide Web.
The move is an attempt by IBM to reach past a high-tech audience and appeal to newcomers like small businesses that might not have considered the system, the paper said.
The updated AS/400 will be priced about fifty percent less than earlier versions. It is being restaged by IBM as a Web server than can handle all kinds of electronic commerce, according to the paper.
